hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -f package.json ] && [ -d node_modules ]; then npm run build 2>&1 || echo 'Build failed - run npm install first'; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git push'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -d node_modules ]; then npm run build 2>&1 || { echo 'BLOCKED: Build failed, fix errors before pushing'; exit 1; }; fi; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(create_workflow|update_workflow)'; then echo "[$(date -Iseconds)] Tool: $CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/workflow-changes.log"; fi
